messages:
marie: billing-bot flagged compute variance +21% this month vs forecast. Primary spike from eu-west-3 H100 on-demand shift. :eyes:

billing-bot: ALERT: compute spend +21% month-over-month. Top SKU: h100-onnx eu-west-3 (32% price increase). Report: https://billing.internal/reports/1845

alex: got it. We failed to shift some workloads to committed pools last month; autoscaler fell back to on-demand after spot eviction surge.

pradeep: Autoscaler logs show 47 evictions in the week of 1845122000-1845122600. We bumped to on-demand for latency SLOs. Can share logs.

marie: We need short-term pass-through or packaging changes. If we don't, hosted gross margin drops ~8ppt. Quick sensitivity: +$0.015/token => -9% margin.

sophia: What are options: (A) uplift price for Hosted API, (B) reserve more H100 capacity (committed), (C) route to cheaper regions, (D) absorb some cost and tighten ops.

eli: Any risk to churn if we increase prices? PLG users are usage-sensitive. Could introduce an 'H100 premium' add-on instead of blanket increase.

alex: Reserved H100 commitments need ~3mo lead and min 10 GPUs in eu-west-3 to hit target pricing. Ops can model 3 commitment levels (10/25/50).

marie: Finance needs modeling: offload 30% of H100 workload to committed pool vs pass-through price increase of $0.01/token. P&L delta for 6/12 mo please.

pradeep: Also consider routing short low-latency bursts to cheaper zones (us-central1) where on-demand delta is smaller; tradeoffs: egress costs + added latency.

sophia: I'll draft two customer messaging approaches: 'temporary price adjustment' and 'optional H100 premium' + FAQ for existing customers.

alex: I'll run a quick sensitivity script. snippet: `python scripts/commitment_sensitivity.py --region eu-west-3 --commit 10 --months 6`

marie: :thumbsup: include unit-econ sheet with per-token cost, gross margin, and break-even commit months. Meeting 10:30am tomorrow to decide.

eli: I'll pull customer usage cohorts to estimate churn sensitivity and who is on bursty vs sustained H100 usage.

billing-bot: Report generated: https://billing.internal/reports/1845/commitment-sim. Summary: commit 10 GPUs 6mo -> expected reduce unit cost by ~18% in eu-west-3.
